statement: OpenAI unveiled Jalapeno, its first custom inference chip, built on TSMC 3nm with Broadcom as ASIC partner and six HBM4 stacks per package.
why: A large model developer shipping its own inference silicon is direct alternative supply that can displace merchant-GPU racks for inference workloads.

impact.mechanism: Custom inference silicon from a top model developer substitutes for merchant GPUs on its own workloads while adding foundry and ASIC demand.

evidence.excerpt: OpenAI unveiled its first custom inference chip, Jalapeno, just ahead of NVIDIA's latest earnings report on August 26.

confidence.basis: Secondary trade coverage; the headline benchmark comparisons are explicitly not apples-to-apples because speculative decoding was disabled on Jalapeno but used for the competing rack results.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: TrendForce
